name: incinerator-felindroid-enter-banishes-two-fire-cards-and-deals-three-damage
notes: Incinerator Felindroid On Enter: banish two fire cards from the graveyard, deal 3 damage to target ally. Pre-fix the two cards could never be chosen ($fireCards undefined).

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Enter: You may banish two fire element cards from your graveyard. When you do, as a Spell, deal 3 damage to target ally.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Incinerator Felindroid: the generated On Enter handler ($fireCards) read a variable that was only defined in the ability body that queued it (PHP closures do not share scope), so it was undefined (null) at resolution. Overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php; the value is recomputed where it is used.
